widget.title: Attendance
widget.autoClockedIn: Clocked you in because you started work
widget.autoUndoHint: If this is wrong, you can undo it now. Undoing also stops the work timer.
widget.seenEarlier: You were here from {{time}} today. If that's when you started, fix the time.

my.empty: No records yet. They will appear once you start work.
my.autoClosedHint: Closed automatically because clock-out was never pressed. Ask an admin to correct it.

leave.grantHint: To correct, enter a negative number — or click a member in «Leave overview» below to edit or delete their grants.

balance.thisRequest: This request counts as {{days}} workday(s) (days off and holidays excluded)
balance.short: {{days}} day(s) short. Choose an unpaid leave type, or ask an admin to grant more.
balance.none: No {{cat}} granted this year. An admin can grant it in Settings > Attendance.

linkedDecided.approved: {{name}}'s request for {{date}} has already been approved.
linkedDecided.rejected: {{name}}'s request for {{date}} has already been rejected.

team.title: {{year}} leave overview
team.hint: Numbers are «left / granted». Click a row to edit or delete that member's grants.
team.deleteMsg: Delete the {{days}}-day {{type}} grant. It will be removed from the balance.

err.grant_below_used: Can't go below leave that's already approved. Cancel that leave first
err.invalid_days: Days must be in 0.5 steps, non-zero, up to 366

settings.autoClockIn: Clock in when I start work
settings.autoClockInHint: If you start a task in Q Task and have no record today, you are clocked in automatically.
settings.promptOnHint: When you first come in we ask «Have you started work?», and the day after a missed clock-out we ask once if the time is right.

promptStatus.asking: Asking now — if you don't see the window, press «Ask again».
promptStatus.snoozed: You answered «Not yet», so we won't ask until {{time}}.
promptStatus.not_today: You answered «Not today» (or «Not yet» 3 times), so we won't ask again today.
promptStatus.checked_in: You already have a clock-in today, so we won't ask.
promptStatus.day_off: Today is a day off (work hours or holiday), so we won't ask.
promptStatus.leave: You are on full-day leave today, so we won't ask.
promptStatus.before: Today we ask when you first come in between {{from}} and {{until}} (from 2 hours before work starts).
promptStatus.error: Couldn't check whether to ask right now. Please reopen in a moment.

error.not_working: You are not working right now.
error.not_on_break: You are not on a break.
error.overlapping_leave: You already have leave requested for these dates.
error.already_started: Leave that has already started can only be canceled by an admin.
error.generic: Could not complete. Please try again.
error.fix_reason_required: Please enter a reason for the correction.
error.timeline_must_start_with_clock_in: A clock-in time is required — the corrected record must start with one.
error.no_workdays_in_range: There are no workdays in the selected dates (only weekends or holidays).

stats.title: Team stats
stats.overtimeHint: ‘Over baseline’ totals time past each person's daily baseline. With flexible hours some days run over and others under — this is not a legal overtime figure.
stats.autoClosedHint: Days auto-closed for a missed clock-out that the person hasn't confirmed or corrected yet

fix.title: Correct attendance
fix.appendOnlyHint: Nothing is erased. Correct the times below; the originals stay as history and the totals are recalculated.
fix.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Forgot to clock out; correcting to actual time
fix.timelineHint: What you leave here becomes the record for this day. Fix or remove wrong times — the originals are kept as history.

admin.desc: Approve leave, see team status, and review monthly stats. Your own clock-in and leave requests live under “Attendance” on the left.

correct.title: Correct attendance
correct.reasonPh: e.g. I left right after the meeting but auto clock-out closed later
correct.notice: Applied immediately. The original record is kept as history and managers are notified.
correct.sentPending: Sent for approval. It applies once your admin approves; until then the original record counts.
correct.noticeApproval: Applies once your admin approves. Until then the original record counts, and it stays in the history.
correct.noticeEither: Depending on workspace settings this applies right away or after admin approval. The original record stays in the history.

presence.title: Team today
presence.hint: Status only · times and records are not shown

module.title: Use attendance & leave
module.descOn: Clock-in records, leave requests and approvals. Turning this off hides the Attendance menu and clock-in widget for everyone.
module.descOff: Turned off. The Attendance menu, clock-in widget and leave notifications are hidden. Records are kept and come back when you turn it on.
module.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change this.
module.offConfirmMsg: For every member, the Attendance menu, sidebar clock-in widget, teammate status dots, leave approvals and leave notifications will disappear. Auto clock-in on task start stops and leave is no longer deducted from capacity. Records are not deleted and come back when you turn it on again.
module.saveError: Could not save. Please try again shortly.

prompt.title: Have you started work?
prompt.body: You first came in at {{time}} today.
prompt.closeLine: You didn't clock out on {{date}}, so we closed it at {{time}}. Is that right?
prompt.hintEdit: A changed time is marked «edited by you» and your admin will see it.
prompt.hintApproval: A changed time applies once your admin approves it. Until then the first-seen time is kept.
prompt.sentPending: Sent for approval. It applies once approved.

err.generic: Couldn't save. Please try again shortly.
err.future_time_not_allowed: You can't enter a time later than now.
err.not_today: Only times within today can be entered.
err.self_fix_window_expired: For records older than 14 days, ask your admin to correct them.
err.outside_work_date: Only times within that date can be entered.
err.not_auto_closed: Only auto-closed days can be fixed here.
err.already_clocked_in_today: You already have a clock-in today.

fixAdmin.approvalOffDesc: Off — when members change a time it applies right away; admins just mark it «Checked» below.
fixAdmin.approvalOnDesc: On — times members change apply only after admin approval. Until then the originally recorded time counts.
fixAdmin.rejectPh: Reason for rejecting (required — the member sees it)

err.generic: Couldn't process. Please try again shortly.
err.day_changed: This day's record changed in the meantime. Ask the member to request again.
err.cannot_decide_own: Another admin handles your own request.
